evidence.description: SYNTHETIC evaluation fixture: 1000 events/second. A failing database pool acquisition takes 30 seconds before returning a transient connection error. Kafka stall monitoring warns after 300 seconds with unchanged nonzero in-flight bytes and no commits; max.poll.interval is 1800 seconds, as configured in this revision. These are not live production observations.

rubric: Fixed-retry control: this revision replaces attempt counts with elapsed-time budgets. Do not repeat the first revision's roughly 23-minute attempt-count mechanism as an introduced defect.

For the supplied 30-second failures, trace the elapsed-time calculation and remaining retry backoff. Distinguish one in-flight attempt overshooting a deadline from the former unbounded aggregate attempt time.
Only flag an additional concrete introduced reliability mechanism supported by the changed code and fixture. High traffic or an intentional temporary delay alone is not a finding.
This is a control for a known mechanism, not a guarantee that the entire revision is bug-free. Validate changed-line citations and classify any new findings manually.
